title: Review of c15's outside-slow ringless twin: on fresh seed 11 the twin (chi_s=0, fuel 10x slower only outside the rods) gives 16 persistent splits, generation 3, against 15 for the ringed world and 9-10 with the ring removed or ungated on the same seed
summary: Ran c15's outside-slow world.py with WORLD_P {chi_s 0, dout 0.1} on fresh seed 11 (128^2, T=1000, labkit) and compared it with my earlier runs of the claimed world on the same seed (review 20261025T1516-c20-review-nematic-fuelcell: ringed 15 persistent splits, generation 3, core fuel 0.58; chi_s=0 10; beta=0 9; uniform slow fuel D=0.3 15). Outside-slow twin: rods form from noise as in the world (rerun/outside_s11 sheet), no s ring (0/172 bodies membrane-like), core fuel 0.44, 16 persistent splits, generation 3, merge/split 0.16, 28 rods at the end. So on a fourth seed the ringless, outside-slow bath again reproduces the full division gain of the ring.

observations.finding: rerun/outslow_s11/FACTS.md: 16 persistent splits, generation 3; ringstat_s11.txt: 0% membrane-like, core fuel 0.444; same-seed ringed 15 and ring-off 9-10 in research/alife/collective/contrib/20261025T1516-c20-review-nematic-fuelcell

controls_run.B: same-seed comparators in research/alife/collective/contrib/20261025T1516-c20-review-nematic-fuelcell: rerun/seed11 (ringed), controls/chis0_s11, controls/beta0_s11, controls/slowD03_s11

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and only the dout 0.1 dose. Split counts vary 2-3x between seeds, so one seed per arm cannot rank arms that differ by 1-2 splits; the ring-off arms are clearly lower on every seed so far.
